chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The merit of the earliest time over the later time is better for the believer than his children and his wealth."

key_terms.الْأَخِيرِ: the later part of the time
key_terms.الْأَوَّلِ: the earliest or first part of the time
key_terms.الْوَقْتِ: the prescribed time for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: Why is praying at the earliest time considered better than worldly blessings like children and wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense virtue of performing salat (prayer) in its earliest prescribed time. It teaches that the spiritual reward of praying at the beginning of the time outweighs even a believer's attachment to children and wealth.
